title: Pointing to Where It Hurts
situation: A patient at a clinic uses simple body-part words to explain where the pain is.
somali_situation: Bukaan jooga rug caafimaad ayaa adeegsanaya erayo fudud oo qaybaha jirka ah si uu u sharxo meesha xanuunku ka hayo.
key_phrases: My stomach hurts.
Is the pain on the left side or the right side?
Can you point to it on this body chart?
It is here, on the right side.
The nurse will check you next.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Hello. My stomach hurts.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Caloosha ayaa i xanuunaysa.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic staff
dialogue.english: I'm sorry to hear that. Is the pain on the left side or the right side?
dialogue.somali: Waan ka xumahay. Xanuunku ma dhinaca bidix baa mise dhinaca midig?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: It is here, on the right side.
dialogue.somali: Waa halkan, dhinaca midig.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic staff
dialogue.english: Can you point to it on this body chart?
dialogue.somali: Jaantuskan jirka ma ku tilmaami kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Yes. It is below my ribs.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Waxay ka hooseysaa feerahayga.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic staff
dialogue.english: Do you also have pain in your back?
dialogue.somali: Dhabarkana xanuun ma ka dareemaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: No, only my stomach.
dialogue.somali: Maya, caloosha oo keliya.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic staff
dialogue.english: Thank you. The nurse will check you next.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Kalkaalisada ayaa marka xigta ku eegi doonta.

title: Describing Symptoms at Reception
situation: A patient describes fever, cough, and tiredness at a clinic reception desk.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa miiska soo-dhoweynta rug caafimaad ku sharxaya qandho, qufac, iyo daal.
key_phrases: I have a fever and a cough.
When did it start?
It started yesterday evening.
My throat is sore, and I feel very tired.
The nurse will take your temperature first.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Good morning. I have a fever and a cough.
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan. Qandho iyo qufac ayaan qabaa.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: When did it start?
dialogue.somali: Goorma ayay bilaabatay?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: It started yesterday evening.
dialogue.somali: Waxay bilaabatay fiidnimadii shalay.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Do you have any other symptoms?
dialogue.somali: Calaamado kale ma leedahay?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: My throat is sore, and I feel very tired.
dialogue.somali: Cunahaygu wuu i xanuunayaa, aadna waan u daalanahay.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Have you taken any medicine today?
dialogue.somali: Maanta wax daawo ah ma qaadatay?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Only paracetamol this morning.
dialogue.somali: Saaka kaliya paracetamol ayaan qaatay.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: All right. Please sit near the nurse's room.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Fadlan fadhiiso meel u dhow qolka kalkaalisada.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Will someone check my temperature?
dialogue.somali: Qof ma hubin doonaa heerkulkayga?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Yes, the nurse will take your temperature first.
dialogue.somali: Haa, kalkaalisada ayaa marka hore heerkulkaaga cabbiri doonta.

title: Explaining Pain to the Doctor
situation: A patient tells a doctor about stomach pain, answers follow-up questions, and hears the next steps.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa dhakhtar u sheegaya calool xanuun, ka jawaabaya su'aalo dabagal ah, kadibna maqlaya tallaabooyinka xiga.
key_phrases: The pain comes and goes, but it is worse at night.
Is it worse after you eat?
I'll examine your stomach now.
You may need a blood test.
Drink plenty of fluids.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.english: Tell me what brought you in today.
dialogue.somali: Ii sheeg waxa maanta kuu keenay.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: I have stomach pain. It started two days ago.
dialogue.somali: Calool xanuun ayaan qabaa. Laba maalmood ka hor ayuu bilaabmay.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.english: Is the pain sharp, or does it come and go?
dialogue.somali: Xanuunku ma fiiqan yahay mise wuu yimaadaa oo tagaa?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: The pain comes and goes, but it is worse at night.
dialogue.somali: Xanuunku wuu yimaadaa oo tagaa, laakiin habeenkii ayuu ka daran yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.english: Is it worse after you eat?
dialogue.somali: Ma wuu ka sii daraa markaad wax cunto?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Sometimes. I also feel a little sick.
dialogue.somali: Mararka qaar. Sidoo kale xoogaa lalabbo ayaan dareemaa.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.english: I'll examine your stomach now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda calooshaada ayaan baari doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: All right. Should I lie down here?
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Halkan ma jiifsadaa?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.english: Yes, please. After that, you may need a blood test.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan. Taas ka dib waxaa laga yaabaa inaad u baahato baaritaan dhiig.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Is it serious?
dialogue.somali: Ma arrin culus baa?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.english: It may be a stomach infection, but we should check first.
dialogue.somali: Waxaa laga yaabaa inuu yahay caabuq caloosha ah, laakiin marka hore waa inaan hubinno.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.english: For now, rest and drink plenty of fluids.
dialogue.somali: Hadda naso oo cab cabitaan badan.

title: Collecting Medicine at the Pharmacy
situation: A customer brings a prescription, asks how to take the medicine, checks side effects, and confirms payment.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa farmashiye keena warqad daawo, wuxuu weydiinayaa sida daawada loo qaato, waxyeellooyinka hubinayaa, kadibna lacag bixinta xaqiijinayaa.
key_phrases: I have a prescription from the doctor.
Take one tablet twice a day after food.
Should I finish the whole course?
It may make you feel drowsy, so avoid driving at first.
Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. I have a prescription from the doctor.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Waxaan hayaa warqad daawo oo dhakhtarku ii qoray.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Let me have a look. This is an antibiotic.
dialogue.somali: Aan eego. Tani waa antibiyootik.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How should I take it?
dialogue.somali: Sideen u qaataa?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Take one tablet twice a day after food.
dialogue.somali: Qaado hal kaniini laba jeer maalintii, cuntada ka dib.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Should I finish the whole course?
dialogue.somali: Daawada oo dhan ma dhammeeyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Yes, even if you feel better after a few days.
dialogue.somali: Haa, xitaa haddii aad maalmo ka dib fiicnaato.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Are there any side effects?
dialogue.somali: Waxyeellooyin ma jiraan?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: It may make you feel drowsy, so avoid driving at first.
dialogue.somali: Waxay kaa dhigi kartaa hurdoole, markaa marka hore iska ilaali wadista.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I take it with my blood pressure medicine?
dialogue.somali: Ma la qaadan karaa daawadayda cadaadiska dhiigga?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Yes, but leave two hours between the doses.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin laba saacadood u dhexeeysi labada qiyaasood.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Could you write that on the label?
dialogue.somali: Taas calaamadda daawada ma ku qori kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Of course. I will add it in large print.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Qoraal waaweyn ayaan ku dari doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How much is it?
dialogue.somali: Waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: It is twelve dollars with your discount.
dialogue.somali: Qiimo dhimistaada kadib waa laba iyo toban doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I pay by card?
dialogue.somali: Kaar ma ku bixin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Yes. Tap your card when the screen lights up.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Kaarka taabo marka shaashaddu iftiinto.

title: Finding the Right Hospital Ward
somali_title: Helidda qaybta saxda ah ee isbitaalka
situation: A visitor at a hospital asks where to go for a patient on the children's ward.
somali_situation: Booqde jooga isbitaal ayaa weydiinaya meesha uu u aado bukaan ku jira qaybta carruurta.
key_phrases: I'm here to visit a patient.
Which ward is the patient on?
The children's ward is on the second floor.
Take the lift on the left.
Visiting time ends at seven.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Hello. I'm here to visit a patient.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Waxaan u imid inaan bukaan booqdo.

dialogue.speaker: Hospital receptionist
dialogue.english: Welcome to City Hospital. Which ward is the patient on?
dialogue.somali: Ku soo dhowow Isbitaalka City. Bukaanku qaybtee ayuu ku jiraa?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: The children's ward, I think.
dialogue.somali: Qaybta carruurta, sida aan u maleynayo.

dialogue.speaker: Hospital receptionist
dialogue.english: The children's ward is on the second floor.
dialogue.somali: Qaybta carruurtu waxay ku taallaa dabaqa labaad.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Where is the lift?
dialogue.somali: Wiishku xaggee buu ku yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Hospital receptionist
dialogue.english: Take the lift on the left.
dialogue.somali: Qaado wiishka bidixda ku yaal.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Thank you. What time does visiting end?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Booqashadu goorma ayay dhammaataa?

dialogue.speaker: Hospital receptionist
dialogue.english: Visiting time ends at seven.
dialogue.somali: Waqtiga booqashadu wuxuu dhammaadaa toddobada.

title: Checking How to Take Medicine
situation: A patient checks dosage, timing, and what to do if a dose is missed.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa hubinaya qiyaasta daawada, waqtiga la qaato, iyo waxa la sameeyo haddii qiyaas la seego.
key_phrases: How many tablets should I take?
Take one in the morning and one in the evening.
Should I take it with food?
What if I miss a dose?
Take it after food with a full glass of water.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: How many tablets should I take?
dialogue.somali: Immisa kaniini ayaan qaataa?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Take one in the morning and one in the evening.
dialogue.somali: Hal qaado subaxdii, midna fiidkii.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Should I take it with food?
dialogue.somali: Cunto ma la qaataa?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Yes, take it after food with a full glass of water.
dialogue.somali: Haa, cuntada ka dib ku qaado koob biyo ah oo buuxa.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: What if I miss a dose?
dialogue.somali: Haddii aan qiyaas seego maxaan sameeyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Take it when you remember, unless it is almost time for the next one.
dialogue.somali: Qaado markaad xasuusato, haddii aysan ku dhowaan waqtigii qiyaasta xigta.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Should I take two tablets together then?
dialogue.somali: Markaas laba kaniini ma wada qaataa?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: No, do not take two doses together.
dialogue.somali: Maya, laba qiyaasood ha wada qaadan.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: All right. I will set an alarm.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Digniin telefoon ayaan dhigan doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Good idea. That will help you take it on time.
dialogue.somali: Fikrad fiican. Taasi waxay kaa caawin doontaa inaad waqtigeeda qaadato.

title: Booking an Urgent Dental Appointment
somali_title: Qabashada ballan ilko oo degdeg ah
situation: A patient calls a dental clinic about tooth pain, asks for the earliest appointment, and checks what to do meanwhile.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa rug ilko ka wacaya ilig xanuun, wuxuu codsanayaa ballanta ugu horreysa, kadibna hubinayaa waxa uu sameeyo inta uu sugayo.
key_phrases: I have a bad toothache.
Is your face swollen?
The earliest appointment is tomorrow morning at nine.
Avoid chewing on that side, and use pain relief if you can take it.
Call us back if the swelling gets worse.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Hello. I have a bad toothache.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Ilig aad ayuu ii xanuunayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Dental receptionist
dialogue.english: I'm sorry. Is your face swollen?
dialogue.somali: Waan ka xumahay. Wajigaagu ma bararay?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: A little, near my jaw.
dialogue.somali: Xoogaa, daankayga agtiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Dental receptionist
dialogue.english: Do you need an urgent appointment?
dialogue.somali: Ballan degdeg ah ma u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Yes, please. I could not sleep last night.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan. Xalay ma seexan karin.

dialogue.speaker: Dental receptionist
dialogue.english: The earliest appointment is tomorrow morning at nine.
dialogue.somali: Ballanta ugu horreysa waa berri subax sagaalka.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: I'll take it. What should I do today?
dialogue.somali: Waan qaadanayaa. Maanta maxaan sameeyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Dental receptionist
dialogue.english: Avoid chewing on that side, and use pain relief if you can take it.
dialogue.somali: Dhinacaas ha ku calalin, daawo xanuun baabi'iye ahna qaado haddii aad qaadan karto.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Should I bring anything?
dialogue.somali: Wax ma soo qaataa?

dialogue.speaker: Dental receptionist
dialogue.english: Bring a list of any medicine you take.
dialogue.somali: Soo qaado liiska daawooyinka aad qaadato.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Thank you. I'll be there at nine.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Sagaalka ayaan imaan doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Dental receptionist
dialogue.english: Call us back if the swelling gets worse.
dialogue.somali: Nala soo xiriir haddii bararku sii xumaado.

title: Calling About Chest Pain
situation: A caller reports chest pain for an older relative and follows emergency instructions.
somali_situation: Qof wacaya ayaa ka warbixinaya laab xanuun ku dhacay qof waayeel ah, wuxuuna raacayaa tilmaamaha gurmadka.
key_phrases: My father has chest pain, and he looks very pale.
Is he awake and breathing?
An ambulance is on the way.
Do not give him anything to eat or drink.
Stay on the line with me until they reach you.

dialogue.speaker: Emergency operator
dialogue.english: Emergency services. What is the problem?
dialogue.somali: Adeegga gurmadka. Maxaa dhacay?

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: My father has chest pain, and he looks very pale.
dialogue.somali: Aabbahay laabta ayaa xanuunaysa, wejigiisuna aad buu u caddaanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Emergency operator
dialogue.english: Is he awake and breathing?
dialogue.somali: Ma soo jeedaa oo ma neefsanayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: Yes, but his breathing is heavy.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin neefsashadiisu way culus tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Emergency operator
dialogue.english: Tell me the address first.
dialogue.somali: Marka hore ii sheeg cinwaanka.

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: We are at 18 Market Road, flat three.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan joognaa 18 Market Road, guri dabaq saddexaad.

dialogue.speaker: Emergency operator
dialogue.english: An ambulance is on the way.
dialogue.somali: Ambalaas ayaa jidka ku soo jirta.

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: Should I give him water?
dialogue.somali: Biyo ma siyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Emergency operator
dialogue.english: No. Do not give him anything to eat or drink.
dialogue.somali: Maya. Wax cunto ama cabitaan ah ha siin.

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: He wants to lie down.
dialogue.somali: Wuxuu rabaa inuu jiifsado.

dialogue.speaker: Emergency operator
dialogue.english: Help him sit in a comfortable position if he can.
dialogue.somali: Haddii uu awoodo, ka caawi inuu fadhiisto si raaxo leh.

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: The front door is unlocked.
dialogue.somali: Albaabka hore wuu furan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Emergency operator
dialogue.english: Good. Turn on the outside light if it is dark.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican. Haddii ay mugdi tahay, nalka bannaanka shid.

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: I can hear the siren now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waxaan maqlayaa qaylada ambalaaska.

dialogue.speaker: Emergency operator
dialogue.english: Stay on the line with me until they reach you.
dialogue.somali: Khadka igula sii jir ilaa ay kuu yimaadaan.

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: I will. Thank you for helping me.
dialogue.somali: Waan sii joogi doonaa. Waad ku mahadsan tahay caawinta.

title: Booking a Pregnancy Check-up
situation: A pregnant patient books a simple check-up and asks what to bring.
somali_situation: Bukaan uur leh ayaa qabsanaya baaritaan fudud, waxayna weydiinaysaa waxa ay soo qaadato.
key_phrases: I am pregnant, and I need a check-up.
I need a check-up.
Can you come on Monday morning?
Bring your pregnancy notes if you have them.
Drink water before you come.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Hello. I am pregnant, and I need a check-up.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Uur ayaan leeyahay, baaritaanna waan u baahanahay.

dialogue.speaker: Midwife
dialogue.english: Of course. How many weeks pregnant are you?
dialogue.somali: Haye. Immisa toddobaad ayaad uur leedahay?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: About twelve weeks.
dialogue.somali: Qiyaastii laba iyo toban toddobaad.

dialogue.speaker: Midwife
dialogue.english: Can you come on Monday morning?
dialogue.somali: Isniinta subax ma imaan kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Yes, Monday morning is fine.
dialogue.somali: Haa, Isniinta subax way ii fiican tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Midwife
dialogue.english: Bring your pregnancy notes if you have them.
dialogue.somali: Haddii aad haysato qoraallada uurka, soo qaado.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Should I do anything before I come?
dialogue.somali: Wax ma sameeyaa ka hor inta aanan imaan?

dialogue.speaker: Midwife
dialogue.english: Drink water before you come.
dialogue.somali: Biyo cab ka hor intaadan imaan.

title: Calling About a Child's Fever
situation: A parent calls a clinic because their child has a fever and asks what to do before the appointment.
somali_situation: Waalid ayaa rug caafimaad wacaya sababtoo ah ilmahiisu qandho ayuu leeyahay, wuxuuna weydiinayaa waxa la sameeyo ka hor ballanta.
key_phrases: My child has a fever.
What is her temperature?
Give her small drinks often.
Does she have a rash or trouble breathing?
Bring her in this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Hello. My child has a fever.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Ilmahaygu qandho ayuu leeyahay.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic nurse
dialogue.english: How old is she?
dialogue.somali: Immisa jir ayay tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: She is three years old.
dialogue.somali: Saddex jir ayay tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic nurse
dialogue.english: What is her temperature?
dialogue.somali: Heerkulkeedu waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: It is thirty-eight point nine.
dialogue.somali: Waa soddon iyo siddeed dhibic sagaal.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic nurse
dialogue.english: Does she have a rash or trouble breathing?
dialogue.somali: Finan ma leedahay mise neefsashadu dhib bay ku tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: No rash, but she is very sleepy.
dialogue.somali: Finan ma laha, laakiin aad bay u hurdo badan tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic nurse
dialogue.english: Give her small drinks often.
dialogue.somali: Cabitaan yar-yar sii marar badan.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Should I bring her to the clinic?
dialogue.somali: Rugta caafimaad ma keenaa?

dialogue.speaker: Clinic nurse
dialogue.english: Yes, bring her in this afternoon.
dialogue.somali: Haa, galabta keen.
